The climate in Szeged

Szeged is about 89 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 600 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 71 mm).

Best time to visit Szeged

The most pleasant weather in Szeged is usually in May and September: average highs are between 22°C and 24°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month.
